Title: Spirit marionetted bleed with daring the dawn.

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
I'm making a distinction between end of action and after this action
is complete. Does it exist?

So the real question is:

What happens first? Daring the Dawn's "after this action is complete"
or spirit marionettes "until the end of the ... action". If they
happen simultaneously, doesn't the acting methuselah get to pick? If
not, then are they TRUELY simultaneous? (if so I've a follow up
question, that I'm holding off to until I get a response).

Note: all quotes are from monger utilities.

~SV
